profile.summary: GPN-Promoter (Hugging Face name gpn-animal-promoter) is a DNA language model trained on promoter sequences from animal genomes. It was released with TraitGym, a benchmark of causal regulatory variants in human genetics. Given a DNA window, it predicts masked nucleotides; the GPN tools turn this into a variant score, the log-likelihood ratio of the alternate against the reference allele, or into sequence embeddings.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: GPN-Promoter belongs to the GPN (GPN-SS) family: single-sequence genomic language models trained on unaligned genomes with masked language modelling. The published config uses the GPN model type with a ByteNet-style convolutional encoder of 64 layers and hidden size 1024, a first kernel size of 9 and later kernel size of 5, with dilation base 2 cycling every 8 layers. The vocabulary has 7 tokens, from the tokenizer gonzalobenegas/tokenizer-dna-mlm named in the training script. The archived training command used a dataset version called v6/512, 64 layers and hidden size 1024, with a total batch size of 2048. For variant scoring, the GPN package compares the model's likelihood of the alternate and reference alleles, averaged over both strands.

sections.title: Versions and reproducibility
sections.body: One model is published, songlab/gpn-animal-promoter, read here at revision 7cf3276a. Intermediate training checkpoints from the same run are in a separate Hugging Face dataset, and the training data are in songlab/gpn-animal-promoter-dataset. The analysis code that produced the model is preserved under the ref analysis-archive-2026-08-18 of the GPN repository. The model card imports gpn.model, while the current GPN docs (commit dc5fd287 read here) load GPN models through register_auto_classes("ss"). A result should name the Hugging Face revision and the GPN package version used to load it.

facts.label: Model type
facts.value: Masked DNA language model (GPN single-sequence family) trained on animal promoter sequences, used for zero-shot variant effect prediction.
facts.source_locator: docs/models/gpn.md; Hugging Face API cardData tags

facts.label: Architecture
facts.value: GPN model with a ByteNet-style dilated convolutional encoder: 64 layers, hidden size 1024, intermediate size 2048, embedding size 768, kernel size 9 then 5, dilation base 2 with cycle 8.

facts.label: Inputs
facts.value: DNA sequence windows tokenised with a 7-token DNA tokenizer. The GPN variant-scoring command takes biallelic SNVs (chrom, one-based pos, ref, alt), a genome FASTA and a window size.

quotes.text: VEP inputs must be biallelic SNVs: `ref` and `alt` are distinct, uppercase, single characters from `A`, `C`, `G`, and `T`.

facts.label: Outputs
facts.value: Masked-nucleotide predictions or embeddings from the model; through the GPN tools, a raw, uncalibrated alternate-minus-reference log-likelihood ratio per variant (negative means the alternate is less likely), averaged over both strands.
facts.source_locator: Model card: Basic usage; docs/getting-started/cli.md: GPN

quotes.text: In particular, negative values mean the alternate is less likely than the reference under the model.

facts.value: Promoter sequences from animal genomes, published as the Hugging Face dataset songlab/gpn-animal-promoter-dataset. The species list, window definition and filtering are in the TraitGym preprint, which could not be read here.

run_guide.summary: Install the GPN package and load the GPN-Promoter masked language model from Hugging Face.
prerequisites: Python 3.13, which the GPN package supports; its Transformers version is pinned.
For CUDA, install PyTorch with the official installer before or alongside GPN. Hardware needs are not stated.
Weights and code are MIT licensed; the weights are not gated.

steps.title: Install GPN
steps.explanation: Installs the model architectures, AutoClass registration, NumPy, PyTorch and Transformers.

quotes.text: This base installation contains the supported model architectures, explicit AutoClass registration, NumPy, PyTorch, Transformers, and jaxtyping.

steps.title: Load the model
steps.shell:
python - <<'PY'
from gpn import register_auto_classes
from transformers import AutoModelForMaskedLM

register_auto_classes("ss")

model = AutoModelForMaskedLM.from_pretrained("songlab/gpn-animal-promoter")
PY
steps.explanation: The GPN docs' quick-start snippet for the GPN family, wrapped in a shell heredoc, with the model name taken from the GPN-Promoter model card in place of songlab/gpn-brassicales. The model card's own snippet imports gpn.model instead.

notes: GPN-Promoter is the name used in TraitGym; the Hugging Face model is songlab/gpn-animal-promoter and the docs call it the animal promoter model. The record's existing attributes (434 animal genomes, 512 bp around TSS, at most one species per family) come from the TraitGym preprint, which could not be fetched here, so they are not repeated on this page.
